articles.summary: CI is chaotic, bursty, spiky, and short-lived. That chaos is a nightmare unless you’re built for it. Blacksmith’s serverless CI cloud thrives on unpredictability: more customers = more noise = smoother utilization = lower costs for everyone. Multitenancy isn’t just efficient — it’s profitable. And yes, the margins are good.
articles.title: How the economics of multitenancy work

articles.summary: We raised $3.5 million from Google Ventures. Now, we're going to use that money to conquer the CI/CD space.
articles.title: Blacksmith Raises $3.5M led by GV and Y Combinator to Build a High-Performance CI Cloud.
